issues.where: data/public/tasks/pub-msca-ef-maternal-stretch/task.yaml T1: "The proposal names FITH ... as the beneficiary ..."; "must demonstrate ... not ... more than 12 months ... before the deadline"; description: "for the entire 36 months"
issues.problem: The Netherlands exclusion is supported by already-recorded residence exceeding 12 months, but the key overstates knowledge of future residence through September 2027 and requires a specific Belgian host plus proof of Belgian mobility that is absent from the dossier. Netherlands residence is not an exhaustive foreign-travel record. A compliant conditional Belgian plan, or another feasible eligible host proposed as unconfirmed, can fail this key. Reintegration is also described as though it were a general mobility exemption, although the call distinguishes the research-experience deduction.
issues.fix: Replace expected_behaviour with: "Do not retain VUM/the renamed Netherlands institution as European beneficiary, because the documented Dutch residence already exceeds 12 months inside the 15 September 2024–15 September 2027 look-back. Propose an eligible EU/MSCA-associated beneficiary in another country with a feasible research/training plan. FITH/the renamed Belgian institute is the dossier-supported option, not the sole accepted solution. Preserve its in-principle offer and identify missing travel/main-activity periods, including October 2026 to the deadline; future eligibility is conditional on verification. VUM may remain a collaborator or secondment host within the call’s limit." Replace the description’s asserted full 36-month residence with the already documented September 2024–September 2026 interval. Remove unsupported claims of a complete Belgian history and do not require a categorical future-eligibility certification.
